findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "I build web products that earn their keep." → 3 lines (8 words, 135.7px); "I care less about the framework and more about w" → 3 lines (18 words, 60px, a paragraph set above 36px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Full-stack web developer" above "I build web products that earn their kee"; "Experience" above "6 YRS"; "03" above "I care less about the framework and more"; "01" above "Marketing sites that convert"; "02" above "Web applications"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: Geist Mono — e.g. "·", "Web Developer", "Work", "About"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "01", "01", "02", "02"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 79 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Full-stack web developer", "01", "Experience", "yrs").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 2 gradient fill(s): div.absolute.-top-[18%] → radial-gradient(circle, lab(71.6167 29.8489 60.7514 / 0.14) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 68%) | div.absolute.-left-[12%] → radial-gradient(circle, oklab(0.760005 0.0704083 0.132451 / 0.16) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.
Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 21 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.lg:col-span-4.lg:border-l 396px | div.mt-[var(--space-xl)].grid 1285px | div.mt-[var(--space-lg)].border-y 1440px | header.rule-top.pt-[var(--space-sm)] 1285px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 1 box(es) drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Prefer a filled surface or no box.

findings.message: 3 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (section #f3f1ed, button #f0eeea, text #f0eeea).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Geist, Geist Mono, Instrument Serif).
findings.fix: Two at most.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 26 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 762px of the width empty: "Tell me what you are building and what it has to a".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "I build web products that" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "earn their keep" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "40+" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Ledgerline" (screen 2, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
